# Fixture for BP-PY-41 (safe) — pytest.fail inside an except suite verifies the
# guarded call outcome (logxide test_doc_codeblocks audit FP shape).
lang: python
file: tests/test_doc_blocks_safe.py
---
def test_doc_codeblock_syntax(block_id, code):
    try:
        compile(code, block_id, "exec")
    except SyntaxError as exc:
        pytest.fail(f"Syntax error in {block_id}: {exc}")
